caveats.feng_2019_limitation: A clean stacked increment rules out only the channels we scored -- not their interactions, and not channels never named (Feng et al. 2019). Track-B maps are lower bounds on the channel set (B-side missing mass > A-side, registry 2026-08-07).
caveats.westfall_yarkoni: Westfall & Yarkoni (2016) incremental-validity caveat: the nuisance scores are single noisy LLM-judged indicators, and unreliability plus large n biases TOWARD declaring signal beyond the nuisance. Positive increments are quoted as a reliability band, never as a point.
caveats.never_quote_against_old_delta_beyond: NEVER quote (d)-(c) against the old Delta_beyond without naming both designs: this arm conditions on the ENRICHED bank plus named nuisance and refits on E, the old one did neither.
